codeReview.summary: Reviewed the feature entry, mission guidance, worker handoff, transcript skeleton for session `824eff39-8c58-421f-a3cc-a18ff5e48012`, the `web-control-plane-worker` skill, shared-state docs, and commit `f31995614069acf3aa7fd90c01bd16a3a9d04e64`. The markup changes in `account-control-plane-sections.tsx` and `linear-management-section.tsx` are directionally correct and align with the browser proof in the handoff, but the new regression does not cover the populated Linear audit state that the original `/account` hydration follow-up came from. The only new semantic assertion runs on a signed-out fixture, while the test fixture still keeps `linearManagement.audit` null, so it never renders the delivery/closeout cards that env-hardening user testing explicitly exercised on the affected route. That leaves the actual audited Linear path unguarded, so the feature does not yet fully satisfy the expected regression-coverage requirement.

issues.description: The new `findDescriptionListViolations` assertion only runs in the signed-out shell test (`apps/web/tests/account-shell.test.tsx:661-680`), and the shared Linear fixture still sets `audit: null` (`apps/web/tests/account-shell.test.tsx:136`). Env-hardening evidence for this follow-up explicitly covered a routed `/account` state with populated delivery and closeout audit data (`.factory/validation/env-hardening-closeout/user-testing/flows/web-env-linear-state.json:23,39`), which is where the changed `DeliveryAuditCard`/`CloseoutAuditCard` markup matters. Because the regression never renders that audited state, a future `dt`/`dd` regression in the real Linear audit path would still pass tests.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission's durable record of the populated `/account` Linear audit state lives in the env-hardening validation artifact, but the shared library docs do not surface that state as a reusable account-shell fixture or follow-up note. That makes it easy for later work to regression-test only `audit: null` shells even when the real routed proof included delivery/closeout cards.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/validation/env-hardening-closeout/user-testing/flows/web-env-linear-state.json:23,39` documents the routed browser state with delivery/closeout evidence, while `.factory/library/web-control-plane.md` and `.factory/library/user-testing.md` only give general shell/bootstrap guidance; the landed test fixture remains `audit: null` in `apps/web/tests/account-shell.test.tsx:136`.

summary: Fail.
